table.name: atoms_bulk_writer_lease
table.shape: single row lock_id=1 CHECK; holder text; taken_at timestamptz; heartbeat timestamptz; expires timestamptz

takeNamedError.throwsWhen: unexpired row exists for a different holder

firstActLeaseDesign.heartbeat: every writePropertyAtomsBatch extends expires by ttl; batch=5000 at ~1k atoms/s is ~5s so 1h ttl is not the Harris-risk
firstActLeaseDesign.takeSemantics: INSERT ON CONFLICT lock_id DO UPDATE only if expires <= now() OR holder matches (refresh). Same holder may re-take. Other unexpired holder = HELD_BY_OTHER.
firstActLeaseDesign.releaseSemantics: DELETE WHERE lock_id=1 AND holder=me; 0 rows = fail closed
firstActLeaseDesign.unitTest: writer without the live lease cannot write — PgStorage.writePropertyAtomsBatch throws ATOMS_WRITER_LEASE_NOT_HELD and never issues INSERT INTO atoms

Empty batch (length 0) returns [] without touching the lease — no write occurred.
Migration MUST be applied to substrate Neon AFTER merge and BEFORE take. Take against a missing table is a defect, not a workaround.
A-012 (2) atoms_section_number_idx partialize-then-drop is planner-executed concurrent, not this PR.
